posts.title: Prime Minister Le Minh Hung chairs 12th CLMV Summit
posts.description: The 12th Cambodia-Laos-Myanmar-Vietnam (CLMV) Summit and the 11th Ayeyawady–Chao Phraya–Mekong Economic Cooperation Strategy (ACMECS) Summit took place on the afternoon of November 28 at the National Convention Center in Hanoi.

posts.title: Authorities prepare evacuations as heavy rain threatens Central region
posts.description: Authorities across the Central region are stepping up preparations for heavy rain and flooding, urging evacuations from high-risk areas and tightening safety measures for reservoirs and transport routes as more downpours are forecast.

posts.title: Landslide cuts off only road to La Lay International Border Gate
posts.description: As of around 8 a.m. on November 28, efforts were underway to clear National Highway 15D, the sole road leading to La Lay International Border Gate in Quang Tri Province, with a view to restoring traffic as soon as possible.
